answers.core: It is Expected behavior for Window to Window communication, and Windows are a part of Core
answers.workaround: Only Reimplementing the desired Window functionallity (such as resizing windows, moving them around etc) seems to be viable, as various methods to try to pass the drag and drop between windows have all failed, often because the subwindow would force itself over anything in the root window

title: Add support for window-to-window drag and drop
